title: rosa communis var. firmula
intro: Rosa communis var. firmula, commonly known as the Wild Rose or Dog Rose, is a perennial plant species within the Rosa genus. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, contributing to its potential in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Rosa communis var. firmula include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and alleviate symptoms of menopause and menstrual disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
